title: Create Core Tables Migration
description: Create the initial Alembic migration that implements the core tables from the database schema design (ARCH005). Tables include: tickets (with JSONB fields for dependencies, file_paths, acceptance_criteria), claims (linking tickets to agents with lease tracking), agents (agent identity registry), machines (machine identity registry), and operators (human operator registry). Include all primary keys, foreign keys, and NOT NULL constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Tickets table created with columns: ticket_id (PK), title, description, type, priority, stage, sdlc_flow (JSONB), dependencies (JSONB), file_paths (JSONB), acceptance_criteria (JSONB), rework_count, created_at, created_by
Claims table created with columns: claim_id (PK), ticket_id (FK), agent_id (FK), machine_id (FK), operator, lease_expiry, claimed_at, released_at
Agents table created with columns: agent_id (PK), agent_name, role, created_at
Machines table created with columns: machine_id (PK), hostname, registered_at, last_seen
Operators table created with columns: operator_id (PK), name, created_at
All foreign key relationships correctly defined with appropriate ON DELETE behavior
Migration downgrades cleanly, dropping all created tables
